title: Women's Club of Milton awards scholarships | Cape Gazette
text:
The Women's Club of Milton awarded $3,000 scholarships to three women residing in the Milton area and entering their freshman year of college. The successful applicants were judged on their academics, community involvement and extracurricular activities. This year, all three recipients are graduates of Cape Henlopen High School.
Ryleigh Archer's passion for animals has led her to pursue a degree in veterinary medicine. She will attend the University of Delaware to study pre-veterinary medicine and then continue with an additional four years of college to complete a doctor of veterinary medicine degree.
Sydney Whetzel plans to study exercise physiology at West Virginia University, where she will work toward becoming a physical therapist.
Rylie Cathcart's joy in helping others has led her to pursue nursing studies. She will attend the University of South Carolina, working toward a bachelor of science degree in nursing. She hopes to continue her education to become a certified registered nurse anesthetist.
The Women's Club of Milton is a member of the General Federation of Women's Clubs, one of the world's oldest and largest service organizations dedicated to community improvement through volunteer service.
For more information, go to womensclubofmilton.org.
